Haikyuu!!

_____
Bokuto has round, golden-colored eyes and spiky white-grey hair with black streaks; certain sections of it are done up as if to vaguely conform to that of an animal, strongly amplifying the uncanny resemblance he bears to a horned owl. He has a solid and muscular build and stands at 6ft 1in. He’s also slightly but very visibly hairy.
_____

He has a playful, friendly, bombastic, and child-like personality and is described by his team as having "mood swings". Because of this, he is at times described as being 'simple minded'. His personality is very compatible that he gets along with many people. Bokuto is oblivious of other people's discomfort. Bokuto often makes jokes about everything and acting rather dramatically about his actions, wanting attention or affirmation from others.

Despite his general silly behavior, there are moments when Bokuto exhibits something akin to a wise form of intelligence.
